title: Affiliate Disclosure
description: How affiliate links work on SignalNest and how they affect (and do not affect) our recommendations.
heading: Affiliate Disclosure
body:
Some links on this site are affiliate links. If you follow one and make a purchase, the seller may pay us a commission. The price you pay is the same.

How this affects our writing

It does not change what we recommend. We do not accept payment to include a product, to give a positive verdict, or to remove criticism. When a product is a poor fit we say so, and when we have not tested something we say that too.

How you can tell

Affiliate links are marked in the article where they appear, and this disclosure is linked from the footer of every page. Outbound commercial links carry rel="nofollow sponsored" where appropriate.

Advertising is separate

Display advertising is sold separately and is always labelled. Advertisers do not see articles before publication and cannot request changes.

Your choice

You are never required to use our links. If you prefer, search for the product yourself; the article's advice stands either way.

Configuration required before launch

List the affiliate programmes you actually belong to, with their names. Do not list programmes you have not joined.
